description: This is a Python module providing asynchronous helper functions for interacting with SEC filings and related data sources. It includes functions for fetching company data, CIK lookup, downloading zip files, and mapping securities to filings, among others.

methods.name: sec_callback(response, session)
methods.description: Handles responses from SEC HTTP requests, returning JSON, HTML, or plain text based on Content-Type.

methods.name: DataFrame get_all_companies(use_cache: bool = True)
methods.description: Fetches a DataFrame of all SEC-registered companies with their symbols, names, and CIK numbers.

methods.name: DataFrame get_all_ciks(use_cache: bool = True)
methods.description: Retrieves a DataFrame listing institutions and their associated CIK numbers.

methods.name: DataFrame get_mf_and_etf_map(use_cache: bool = True)
methods.description: Returns a DataFrame mapping mutual funds and ETFs to their CIKs.

methods.name: DataFrame search_institutions(keyword: str, use_cache: bool = True)
methods.description: Searches for institutions by name keyword, case-insensitive.

methods.name: str symbol_map(symbol: str, use_cache: bool = True)
methods.description: Maps a ticker symbol to its CIK number, with formatting adjustments.

methods.name: str cik_map(cik: Union[str, int], use_cache: bool = True)
methods.description: Converts a CIK number into its corresponding ticker symbol.

methods.name: List get_schema_filelist(query: str = "", url: str = "", use_cache: bool = True)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of SEC schema files based on a query or URL.

methods.name: List[Dict] download_zip_file( url, symbol: Optional[str] = None, use_cache: bool = True )
methods.description: Downloads and extracts data from a ZIP file URL, returning records as dictionaries.

methods.name: Dict get_ftd_urls()
methods.description: Gets URLs for Fails-to-Deliver data from SEC datasets.

methods.name: get_series_id( symbol: Optional[str] = None, cik: Optional[str] = None, use_cache: bool = True )
methods.description: Maps fund symbols or CIKs to their series and class IDs for filings validation.

methods.name: List[Dict] get_nport_candidates(symbol: str, use_cache: bool = True)
methods.description: Retrieves NPORT-P filings for a given fund's symbol.

ctags.name: cik_map
ctags.pattern: /^async def cik_map(cik: Union[str, int], use_cache: bool = True) -> str:$/

ctags.name: download_zip_file
ctags.signature: ( url, symbol: Optional[str] = None, use_cache: bool = True )

ctags.name: get_nport_candidates
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_nport_candidates(symbol: str, use_cache: bool = True) -> List[Dict]:$/

ctags.name: get_schema_filelist
ctags.pattern: /^def get_schema_filelist(query: str = "", url: str = "", use_cache: bool = True) -> List:$/
ctags.signature: (query: str = "", url: str = "", use_cache: bool = True)

ctags.name: get_series_id
ctags.signature: ( symbol: Optional[str] = None, cik: Optional[str] = None, use_cache: bool = True )

ctags.name: search_institutions
ctags.pattern: /^async def search_institutions(keyword: str, use_cache: bool = True) -> DataFrame:$/

ctags.name: symbol_map
ctags.pattern: /^async def symbol_map(symbol: str, use_cache: bool = True) -> str:$/
